notes: Documentation-only metadata for the rule_ids emitted in governance_findings.json's support[].rule_ids by tools/generate_governance_narrative.py's build_structured_findings(). The rule_id constants and the classification logic itself stay in generate_governance_narrative.py/_classify_domains_for_findings() (domain-governance business logic, per D-019/D-020); this file only documents which finding_type each rule_id produces and a human-readable description, for a downstream reader who has a rule_id and wants to know what it means without reading the generator's source.

GOV-TIER-STRONG-BASELINE.description: Domain assigned the Strong Baseline Candidate governance_tier by assign_tier() (primary containment >= tier_strong_baseline_min, no material state exception, no container gap).

GOV-TIER-BASELINE-CANDIDATE.description: Domain assigned a baseline-candidate governance_tier (Strong Baseline, Baseline Candidate — Local/Use Review, or Baseline Candidate — Container Gap) by assign_tier().

GOV-TIER-LOCAL-REVIEW-REQUIRED.description: Domain assigned a governance_tier requiring local/use review (Baseline Candidate — Local/Use Review, Investigate Before Baseline, or Active Local Practice Review) by assign_tier().

GOV-TIER-ACTIVE-LOCAL-PRACTICE.description: Domain assigned the Active Local Practice Review governance_tier, or its local_active_share meets/exceeds local_active_material_threshold, by assign_tier().

GOV-TIER-HIGH-FRAGMENTATION.description: Domain assigned the High Fragmentation governance_tier by assign_tier() (primary containment below tier_moderate_variation_min).

GOV-TIER-INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE.description: Domain assigned an insufficient-evidence governance_tier (Insufficient Evidence, Insufficient Evidence — Enterprise; BC-Level Evidence Available, or Sparse / Presence-Limited) by assign_tier().

GOV-XC-STRONG-CONVERGENCE.description: Domain's cross-client Jaccard mean (xc) meets or exceeds cross_client_convergence_strong.

GOV-PASSIVE-INHERITANCE-RISK.description: Domain is in passive_inheritance_risk_domains (domain_governance_policy.json) and shows a material passive-inheritance signal (passive_indicator or bundle_share_all below the schema-appropriate threshold).

GOV-CLIENT-LOW-COHERENCE.description: Client's within-project coherence mean (wp_mean) is below client_coherence_low.

GOV-LEADERSHIP-QUESTION.description: One of a fixed set of suggested leadership review questions -- a question for human review, not a computed classification of a specific domain or client.
